name: Satellite Communications Security
description: Ability to analyze the security of satellite communication links and protocols. Covers DVB-S/S2 signal analysis, VSAT terminal security, satellite modem protocol assessment, ground segment security evaluation, and analysis of satellite internet services (Ku/Ka-band). Includes identification of unencrypted or weakly protected satellite data streams.

0.label: None
0.description: No exposure to satellite communications security analysis

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands satellite communication architecture and security considerations
evidence: Can describe satellite link budget concepts and common frequency bands (L, S, C, Ku, Ka)
Understands DVB-S/S2 modulation and framing at a conceptual level
Completed training on satellite communications security and known vulnerability classes

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Receives and analyzes satellite signals using appropriate equipment under supervision
evidence: Received DVB-S/S2 satellite signals and decoded transport streams under guidance
Identified satellite carriers, symbol rates, and modulation parameters from spectrum analysis
Analyzed VSAT terminal traffic for unencrypted data streams under supervision

3.label: Independent Practice
3.description: Independently assesses satellite communication link security
evidence: Independently analyzed satellite communication security for 3+ different services or links
Identified unencrypted or weakly protected satellite data streams and characterized exposed data
Assessed VSAT terminal configurations and ground segment security posture
Produced reports documenting satellite link security findings with protocol-level evidence

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Analyzes complex satellite protocols; assesses modern high-throughput satellite security
evidence: Analyzed proprietary satellite modem protocols and identified security weaknesses
Assessed high-throughput satellite (HTS) multi-beam and spot-beam isolation
Developed custom satellite signal analysis and data extraction tools
Mentors junior analysts on satellite communications analysis techniques

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Recognized authority on satellite communications security; defines lab methodology
evidence: Published research on satellite communication security vulnerabilities
Authored the lab's satellite communications security assessment methodology
Assessed security of satellite constellations or advanced satellite networking protocols
Trains teams on satellite communications security and advises operators on link hardening

assessment_methods.description: Receive and analyze a satellite signal: identify modulation, decode transport stream, assess encryption, and characterize any data exposure
Review satellite communications security assessment reports for signal analysis accuracy and finding completeness
